policy.source_precedence: If this registry conflicts with a locked preregistration or archived decision source, the locked source controls and this registry must be corrected without changing the hypothesis.
policy.no_automatic_adoption: PASS only permits a proposal. Production rules change only after independent review, explicit user approval, a new revision record, and deployment.
policy.deadline_handling: A deadline is never silently extended and a sparse result is not converted to PASS. Any extension requires a new preregistration and a fresh sample unless the controlling source explicitly says otherwise.
policy.review_handling: After every integrity review, next_required_review_on must be advanced and the review evidence linked. Missing a review does not alter the locked performance deadline.

active_hypotheses.title: Market-gate-OFF mean-reversion forward stream
active_hypotheses.activation_event: EINT-023 production deployment; the new stream starts from zero and must not be pooled with the earlier gate-ON stream
active_hypotheses.maturity: swing closed 100 AND long_term closed 30, then one combined judgment
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE; no threshold relaxation or pooling
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: Use the D-33 amendment and D-44 combined one-time comparison against the locked same-length D-25 baseline.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Confirm actual deployment/start timestamp, zero-based counters, immutable code/config/cost/data hashes, and that the old gate-ON stream is separate.

active_hypotheses.title: Daily Trend Pullback v2 offline forward observation
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: Apply the locked D-42 deadline rule; do not extend or pool.
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: Independent one-time (a)/(b)/(c) judgment in the locked v2 runner. It is not selected by comparison with v4.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Confirm the offline runner is still accumulating, hashes match, forced_close is excluded, and no website/manual ledger is pooled.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: Independent result only; no website execution or automatic adoption.

active_hypotheses.title: Daily Trend Pullback v4 offline forward observation
active_hypotheses.maturity: 100 closed trades excluding forced_close and including market_regime exits
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: Apply the locked D-43 deadline rule; do not extend or pool.
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: Independent one-time (a)/(b)/(c) judgment in the locked v4 runner. No v2-versus-v4 winner rule is registered.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Confirm the offline runner is still accumulating, hashes match, exit labels are preserved, and no website/manual ledger is pooled.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: Independent result only; no v2/v4 winner selection or automatic adoption.

active_hypotheses.title: Bollinger-RSI rebound-confirmation paired shadow
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: Run the locked judgment with available completed pairs; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS by relaxation.
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: PASS if mean(B-A)>0 and bootstrap 95% lower bound>0; FAIL if upper bound<0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Check new-signal-only enrollment, pair lifecycle, missing_bar handling, preregistration hash, and separation from recommendation outcomes.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: PASS permits proposal only; explicit user approval and a new engine revision are required.

active_hypotheses.title: RSI-OBV plus rising SMA60 paired shadow
active_hypotheses.maturity: B closed 100 AND B/A completion retention at least 20%
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: Use the locked paired bootstrap/PF/lower-tail rules; EINT-043 historical results are reference only.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Check production activation date, shadow file continuity, selected long_term signals only, costs, and preregistration hash.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: PASS permits proposal only; explicit user approval and a new engine revision are required.

active_hypotheses.title: KOSPI crash rebound and foreign-futures-flow prospective observation
active_hypotheses.maturity: 10 independent event-B intervals, with every required 60-session outcome completed
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: Judge each P1-P5 under its locked minimum-count rule; under five events remains HOLD.
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: Wilson-interval overlap rules P1-P5; P4 requires at least five events in both flow groups.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Check event persistence, 20/60-session fills, 20-session independence grouping, and source re-fetch capability.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: Describes a market hypothesis only; a separate preregistered trading hypothesis is required for use.

active_hypotheses.title: Korean large-cap value 24-month prospective portfolio
active_hypotheses.deadline_result_if_immature: Missing month is a data-integrity exception; do not shorten the 24-month test or backfill with revised information.
active_hypotheses.decision_rule: PASS/FAIL/REJECT and -15pp early-stop rules in the locked preregistration.
active_hypotheses.review_scope: Verify the first formation ledger, timestamped commit, source hashes, next-open prices, and monthly evaluation schedule.
active_hypotheses.application_policy: PASS means small-live-use review is allowed, not automatic portfolio adoption.

descriptive_observations.title: Published recommendation outcome horizons
descriptive_observations.review_scope: Coverage and missing-price audit for 1/5/10/20-session descriptive outcomes.
descriptive_observations.research_readiness: MIN_SAMPLE=20 per item/horizon is display readiness, not a strategy PASS threshold.
descriptive_observations.application_policy: Never substitute these proxy horizons for native exit/cost performance.

descriptive_observations.title: Mean-reversion signal-funnel and watch-candidate history
descriptive_observations.review_scope: Check 250-session continuity and quantify where candidates are lost; do not tune from the review.
descriptive_observations.research_readiness: A new filter-relaxation hypothesis requires a separate preregistration and fresh sample.

descriptive_observations.title: Short-selling and stock-lending context accumulation
descriptive_observations.review_scope: Audit 20-day short and 60-day lending completeness, publication-time availability, normalization, and symbol/date coverage.
descriptive_observations.research_readiness: After at least 12 months, 100 valid recommendation-symbol observations and 30 unique symbols may justify preregistering one mixed-factor hypothesis; they do not prove it.
descriptive_observations.application_policy: Reference badge only until a separate mixed-factor hypothesis passes and the user approves it.

descriptive_observations.title: External Korean pick-list outcome tracking
descriptive_observations.review_scope: Publish per-cohort 1/3/6/12-month completeness; never infer a 12-month result from a shorter horizon.
descriptive_observations.research_readiness: First source-level hypothesis review is 2028-10-31 and requires at least 12 cohorts with completed 12-month outcomes.
descriptive_observations.application_policy: Data comparison only; no KQS rule adoption.

descriptive_observations.title: KOSPI futures and cash-flow 92-day reference window
descriptive_observations.review_scope: Audit daily completeness, source timestamps, session alignment, and rolling retention.
descriptive_observations.research_readiness: KR-CRASH-REBOUND-v1 is the only registered outcome hypothesis using this family of data.
